summary.name: HandBrake
summary.one_liner: HandBrake is a free, open-source, volunteer-built video transcoder that converts video from nearly any format to modern, widely supported codecs.
use_cases: Converting video files to modern, widely supported codecs
Converting video from nearly any format
Preparing media for playback on other devices
Batch converting media on Windows, Mac or Linux
summary.what_it_does: HandBrake is an open-source video transcoder built by volunteers. It converts video from nearly any input format into a selection of modern, widely supported codecs. The page describes it as GPL-licensed, multiplatform and multithreaded. The current download listed is version 1.11.2, with a macOS build for 10.13 or later and other platforms available separately.
notable: Converts from nearly any input format to modern codecs
caveats: macOS build requires macOS 10.13 or later
Other platform builds are on a separate download page, not detailed here
